node.title: print a file from Bottom to Top (reverse order)
node.author: theravadamonk
node.doctext:
Hi, Monks, I want to know how to print a file from Bottom to Top (reverse order).

I found this below link with below code

https://www.perlmonks.org/?node_id=361397

open(FILE, "; foreach (@file) { #process line }

Given below is My CODE with while loop, I want to go with while loop. How can I print from Bottom to Top ?

How can I insert reverse order in to while loop?

What's the easiest way ? I DO hope U monks will come with ideas...

#!/usr/bin/perl use CGI ':standard'; use strict; use warnings; use CGI::Carp 'fatalsToBrowser'; # use only for testing #my $date = localtime(); $ENV{"PATH"} = "/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"; open FILE, '<', '/var/log/maillog' or die $!; while (){ chomp; next unless /\S/; # skip blank lines if (/Passed CLEAN/) { #search string Passed CLEAN print "$_ \n"; # print ALL lines containing Passed CLEAN } } close FILE;
